name: TDA2030
description: Monolithic mono class-AB audio power amplifier delivering ~14W into 4 ohm, in the 5-lead Pentawatt (TO-220-5) package. Includes short-circuit and thermal protection. The TDA2030A successor shares this pinout but tolerates a higher supply.

pins.name: IN-
pins.description: inverting (-) input; sets closed-loop gain via the feedback network

pins.name: -Vs
pins.description: negative supply rail; the metal tab is tied to this pin (NOT ground)

Pentawatt.notes: 5-lead Pentawatt (TO-220-5), single inline, numbered 1-5 from the labelled end. The mounting tab is connected to pin 3 (-Vs), so on a split supply the heatsink floats at the negative rail and must be isolated.

typical_application: Single-ended non-inverting class-AB amp on a +/-14V split supply, gain ~30dB (R1=22k / R2=680R feedback), driving a 4 or 8 ohm speaker. Add two 1N4001 output clamp diodes to the rails, a Zobel network (1R + 220nF) at the output, and 100uF + 100nF decoupling per rail.
gotchas: the mounting tab is pin 3 (-Vs), NOT ground; in a dual-supply design the heatsink sits at the negative rail and must be isolated from chassis
TDA2030A is the higher-voltage successor (abs max +/-22V) with the identical 5-pin Pentawatt pinout; the original TDA2030 maxes at +/-18V
shares the Pentawatt pinout with the LM1875, but supply limits differ; do not assume drop-in equivalence
output current internally limited to 3.5A; thermal shutdown and SOA protection are built in
